vectors.purpose: A format-2 handover history with owner-signed control events (§6.1 /2 challenge over the record-chain head), a simulated admission, a receipt, an obligation and a succession replays.
Every prefix of a valid history is valid: the history as it stood before the succession.
A control event without its owner signature is refused (CONTROL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID).
A control event whose signature bytes were altered is refused (CONTROL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID).
Two independently valid, signed grants swapped in position are refused: each signature binds the head before its event (CONTROL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID).
Editing a signed grant's expiry invalidates the owner signature over its effect hash (CONTROL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID).
A control event claiming a key id the genesis does not declare is refused (CONTROL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID).
The format-2 genesis commits the owner keys to the digest of their next key (nextKeyDigests).
A genesis whose next-key commitment names one of its own owner keys is refused (EVENT_DATA_INVALID).
A genesis whose next-key commitment is empty is refused (EVENT_DATA_INVALID).
On a history created without a next-key commitment, OWNER_KEYS_ROTATED signed by the current owner key replaces the owner key set; later control events are signed by the new key.
After a rotation the retired owner key can no longer sign a control event (CONTROL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID).
A rotation signed by a key the history never declared is refused (CONTROL_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID).
A rotation that brings a retired key id back is refused (TRANSITION_INVALID).
A rotation that keeps a key id but binds it to a different public key is refused (TRANSITION_INVALID).
An uncommitted epoch gets a commitment by a rotation that keeps every owner key and carries nextKeyDigests.
A rotation that keeps every owner key and carries no nextKeyDigests changes nothing (TRANSITION_INVALID).
A rotation out of a committed epoch that reveals the committed key with its proof (nextKeyAuthorizations) and commits the new set to its own next key is accepted.
A rotation out of a committed epoch to a key the commitment does not name is refused (TRANSITION_INVALID).
Revealing the committed key without its signature (no nextKeyAuthorizations) is refused (TRANSITION_INVALID).
A pre-rotated rotation without nextKeyDigests is refused (TRANSITION_INVALID): the commitment chain must continue.
